fact_check.claim: New transfers live on campus one academic year; spring transfers live on campus the incoming spring plus the following academic year
fact_check.note: Opened the page: 'required to live on campus for one academic year'; spring transfers 'incoming spring semester as well as the following academic year'.

fact_check.claim: Junior/senior entrants and those with two years of on-campus living elsewhere are exempt; married, dependents, veteran, 21+ exempt; ROTC does not count
fact_check.note: Opened the residential policy page; all listed exemptions and the ROTC exclusion match.

fact_check.claim: Exemption requested in the Housing application when open; not accepted after a signed license; one academic year; transfers reapply each year
April 6, 2026 deadline applies to current first- and second-years (Not confirmed line for new transfers)
fact_check.note: Brief and policy page: 'All first and second-year students'. Page correctly marks the transfer deadline as not confirmed.

fact_check.claim: A student without an exemption is billed for the full year even if they sign a lease
fact_check.note: Page says those who fail to fulfil the requirement or get an exemption 'will still be billed for the full year'. It does not mention leases, but the inference is direct and the page links the right source.

fact_check.claim: 2026-27 rates: double $13,744; triple/one-room quad $12,644; single/townhouse double $15,566; super single $16,595; co-op double $6,974 to $9,962 ($3,487 to $4,981 a semester)

New transfers cannot cancel the license unless they stop attending or are exempt; second-years may cancel for Greek/co-op before Spring Housing Selection deadline; $60 per day outside occupancy; no-show billed 50% of fall room rate
